services.metaDescription: Consulting, training, support and review for small businesses. See what we offer and how we work step by step. Demo content.
services.title: Our services
services.lead: Four services. Order any one alone or combine them.
services.consultingText: One or more sessions to review the business, find the biggest problems and write a plan with steps and dates.
services.trainingText: Practical courses for your team on topics such as customer service, bookkeeping and using digital tools.
services.supportText: A monthly subscription that gets you quick answers and regular follow-up on any problem that appears.
services.reviewText: An independent check of what was done, with a short report on what worked and what needs improvement.
services.step1Text: We start with a short call to understand what you want.
services.step2Text: We send a written offer with the price and the time.
services.step3Text: We work with you, then check the results after delivery.
